scientific_integrity: Proof for all admissible parameters; finite verification is corroborative and separately reproducible. The literature comparison found no covering theorem but cannot establish global uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: The all-parameter theorem is for single fixed-cardinality consecutive windows and vertex-membership queries on paths/cycles. Cyclic full-width windows are singletons and excluded from the cyclic formula. Computer verification extends only through 16 vertices. No independent scientific audit or exhaustive historical-priority verification is claimed.
title: Exact static and adaptive dimensions for constant-width windows on paths and cycles
